name: assert.AssertionError
summary: Indicates the failure of an assertion. All errors thrown by the [assert](api:assert) module will be instances of the `AssertionError` class.

properties.name: actual
properties.summary: Set to the actual argument for methods such as `assert.strictEqual()`.

properties.name: code
properties.summary: Value is always `ERR_ASSERTION` to show that the error is an assertion error.

properties.name: expected
properties.summary: Set to the expected value for methods such as `assert.strictEqual()`.

properties.name: generatedMessage
properties.summary: Indicates if the message was auto-generated (`true`) or not.

properties.name: operator
properties.summary: Set to the passed in operator value.

methods.name: constructor
methods.summary: A subclass of `Error` that indicates the failure of an assertion.

inlined.name: assert.AssertionError.options
inlined.summary: options used in the [assert.AssertionError](api:assert.AssertionError) constructor argument

properties.name: actual
properties.summary: The `actual` property on the error instance.

properties.name: expected
properties.summary: The `expected` property on the error instance.

properties.name: message
properties.summary: If provided, the error message is set to this value.

properties.name: operator
properties.summary: The `operator` property on the error instance.

properties.name: stackStartFn
properties.summary: If provided, the generated stack trace omits frames before this function.
